requested_changes.title: New outer launcher lacks its own failure-complete and actual runtime evidence boundary
facts: The outer directory is created at line25, but helper raw compile/stdlib ctypes load at lines28-29, started receipt, stdio creation and run_owned at lines30-32 have no encompassing try/finally.
completed.json is saved only after run_owned returns. An import/open/owned-call exception leaves a used outer leaf without a structured first origin or nullable actual result/cleanup receipt.

scope.runtime_resources_ref is never read by launch_desktop15.py. The launcher does not inventory its actual __file__/existing __cached__/loaded DLL points; the inner runtime() only observes the separate child interpreter.

The initial launcher grant check only checks booleans/actor; full actual CAS/review/copies verification occurs in the child. No claim is made that outer Python launch itself was independently authorized by that limited check.
requested_changes.requested_fix: New immutable launcher revision: put all post-owned-output stages under first-cause preserving try/finally; persist started/phase plus any actual result and its nullable exit, stdout/stderr refs, cleanup and secondary seal errors. Before loading the helper verify actual launcher Python source/pyc pins against reviewed catalog; after raw helper compile capture actual loaded DLL point(s), and repeat in finally. Include launcher/helper/scope/grant and every consumed immutable actual registration/ref in the input closure. Either perform reusable full grant validation before starting the native child or explicitly bind a Root-owned prelaunch attestation of that same exact closed chain; no authorized:true-only gate. Pre-output failures must be preserved by the explicitly specified Root outer caller, without writing to untrusted paths. Preserve -I -S -X utf8, public env, owned Job, exact1200+5 cap; no added product work.
requested_changes.verification: Static review of new immutable code and scope/launcher pins; future one authorized operation only. No replay is authorized by this finding. Python before/after remains point-in-time, not lifetime attestation.

requested_changes.title: Pre-output refusal and failure finalization do not preserve a single first cause through all stages
facts: Scope/grant/CAS/tool/exact15/protected/output checks occur before the try at line290. Such errors rely on outer raw stderr rather than the claimed controller failure receipt.
In the except block, save(failure.origin.json) is not protected. Failure while writing that file can replace the original exception. after_failure observation write has the same issue.

The finally block hashes every output and saves manifest without its own secondary-error handling or preserved primary cause. Read/stat/hash/manifest errors can replace the actual Git/apply/commit error and its failure status.

failure.origin.actual_native_exit copies last Git observation, which can be 0 during a later Python guard failure. This is a real last-child fact but must be labelled separately from the current controller/failure native exit, which is unknown until an outer observation.
requested_changes.requested_fix: New immutable revision with primary error fixed once, finalization/observation/manifest exceptions accumulated as secondary, never masking or retrying primary. Arrange exact owned-output preparation and preflight persistence with Root launcher contract so initial authorization/path errors have a known raw/origin location. Save each Git invocation actual result/raw before asserting; record last_native_observation separately and keep current controller/unknown native NULL. Attempt complete after observations and manifest even after failures, with bounded fallback stderr if disk persistence fails. Keep one apply/one commit, no automatic reset/rollback/retry and exact15/index/HEAD/CAS/source protections unchanged.
